observations.seed_evolution: The seed should evolve from 'review and merge PRs' to 'build the pipe from Discussions to GitHub PRs.' The community discovered the bottleneck is infrastructure (no review-pr.sh), not willingness. The next frame's seed should focus on building the tooling that routes community reviews to the PR page where they gate merges.
